name: Native Search Enhancements
description: Adds content exclusions, taxonomy results and configurable ranking to Drupal core Search.
project_description:
Release of Native Search Enhancements.

 Features: 
 
 - Exclusion of selected content types from native search indexing and results. 
 - Taxonomy terms returned as independent search results. 
 - Canonical taxonomy term links with URL alias support. 
 - Exact and partial taxonomy term matching. 
 - Configurable content title ranking. 
 - Configurable taxonomy term result influence. 
 - Optional URL fragments for taxonomy result links. 
 - Multilingual taxonomy term support. 
 - Compatibility with Drupal 10 and Drupal 11. 
 
 This release is intended for testing and community feedback. It only supports Drupal core's native Search module and does not integrate with Search API or external search backends.
